designStyle.name: Clean, friendly, sustainability-focused mobile product UI
designStyle.aesthetic: Bright, uncluttered interfaces with a white foundation, restrained green emphasis, dark readable typography, and soft rounded surfaces.
designStyle.density: Low-to-medium; prioritize scanability and clear actions over information packing.
designStyle.hierarchy: One clear page-level purpose, compact supporting copy, then grouped actions or information.
designStyle.whitespace: Use generous outer margins and consistent internal padding; whitespace separates groups rather than decorative ornament.

fontFamily.characteristics: Neutral contemporary sans-serif with high legibility at small sizes.

rules: Reserve the heaviest weights for page titles and primary values.

usage.space_2: Tight control internals and compact list gaps

page.background: Use the background token; reserve pure white for content surfaces.
page.gutter: Use the breakpoint-specific page gutter token.
page.maxWidth: Center wide content and constrain reading/form areas independently.
page.verticalRhythm: Use the spacing scale; separate page header, content sections, and persistent navigation clearly.

structure.mobile: Single-column content flow with persistent bottom navigation for primary app destinations.
structure.tablet: Use wider gutters and two-column layouts only when each column remains comfortably readable.
structure.desktop: Use a centered content region; introduce a side navigation only when the product information architecture requires it.

layout.alignment: Align headings, cards, fields, and list content to a shared page grid.
layout.grids: Use a 4px spacing base and 16px default grid gap; collapse grids before reducing card readability.
layout.headers: Keep top bars compact, with clear back/navigation affordance and one primary title area.
layout.navigation: Keep primary navigation consistent across authenticated screens; visually distinguish the central/high-priority action through position and modest elevation, not a new color palette.

buttons.structure: Single-line label with optional leading or trailing icon.
buttons.primary: Solid primary green, white semibold label, 48px height, 12px radius.
buttons.secondary: White or pale-green surface, primary-colored label, 1px border.
buttons.tertiary: Text-only, no container; use primary color.

states.hover: Slightly darken primary or tint neutral surface.
states.pressed: Use primaryDark and subtle scale/opacity feedback.
states.disabled: Muted text and disabled surface; no shadow.
states.loading: Keep width stable and replace or accompany label with a small progress indicator.

cards.structure: Surface container with optional header, body, and action area.
cards.border: Default border; use card shadow only when separation from the page needs reinforcement.
cards.rules: Avoid nested cards unless hierarchy genuinely requires them.

inputs.structure: Optional label above a full-width control; supporting or validation text below.
inputs.icon: 20px, aligned inside the leading or trailing edge with 12px inset.

states.focus: Focus border plus accessible focus ring.
states.error: Error border and concise helper text.

searchFields.structure: Input with leading search affordance and optional trailing filter/action.

navigation.bottom: Fixed mobile bar with evenly spaced destinations, compact line icons, and short labels.
navigation.selected: Primary color icon and label; inactive items use muted text.
navigation.centralAction: May sit slightly above the bar in a circular or rounded container; maintain clear separation and a 44px or larger target.
navigation.safeArea: Respect device bottom inset and avoid covering scrollable content.

tabs.structure: Compact horizontal row with clear selected indicator.
tabs.selected: Primary color label with underline or pale primary surface.

badges.variants: Use semantic success, warning, error, or information colors with a very light matching background.

dropdowns.trigger: Match input height, border, and radius.
dropdowns.menu: White surface, 12px radius, floating shadow, 8px item padding.
dropdowns.selection: Use primary tint and a check/selection indicator.

tables.structure: Use only for dense comparative data; prefer stacked rows on mobile.

modals.structure: Centered dialog on desktop; bottom sheet or full-height panel on narrow mobile where appropriate.

alerts.structure: Icon, concise message, optional action; align icon to first text line.
alerts.color: Use semantic tint backgrounds with readable foreground contrast.

avatars.fallback: Initials or neutral silhouette on a pale neutral/primary tint.

lists.row: Leading icon/avatar, flexible text stack, optional trailing status or chevron.
lists.divider: Subtle divider inset to align with text content.

sections.structure: Section heading and optional supporting action followed by grouped content.

emptyStates.structure: Simple illustration or icon, short heading, one supporting sentence, optional primary action.

loadingStates.behavior: Use restrained progress indicators or skeleton surfaces that preserve final layout dimensions.
loadingStates.color: Primary for active progress; neutral surfaces for skeletons.

iconography.style: Consistent simple outline icons with rounded joins; use filled treatment only for selected or semantic emphasis.
iconography.alignment: Optically center icons with text; use 8px gap for inline icon-label pairs.
rules: Do not mix detailed illustrative icons with minimal interface icons.
Keep icons secondary to labels unless the control is universally recognizable.

principles: Establish hierarchy primarily through type scale, weight, and spacing.
Use primary green for the main action and selected navigation state, not for every decorative element.
Use surface contrast and subtle borders to group related information.
Keep secondary metadata smaller and lower contrast while preserving accessibility.
Limit each view to one visually dominant action where possible.
visualHierarchy.order: Page purpose → primary action or key information → supporting groups → secondary metadata.

mobile.layout: Single column; full-width controls; bottom navigation for core app areas.
mobile.cards: Stack vertically; avoid multi-column content cards.
mobile.type: Use defined scale; reduce display headings by one step only when needed.

tablet.layout: Use 2 columns for independent content groups when useful.
tablet.navigation: Retain compact navigation or adapt to a rail based on app shell.

desktop.layout: Centered max-width content; optional sidebar plus main content.
desktop.forms: Constrain forms to formMaxWidth rather than stretching.
desktop.navigation: Use a persistent side rail only if the overall application shell supports it.

responsive.general: Preserve touch target sizes, readable line lengths, and content order; reflow rather than simply shrink.

interactionStates.default: White surface, neutral border, readable text.
interactionStates.hover: Subtle surface tint or small elevation increase; avoid dramatic movement.
interactionStates.focus: Visible focus ring using the focus token.
interactionStates.active: Primary tint or primaryDark treatment with immediate feedback.
interactionStates.selected: Primary color plus a secondary cue such as underline, check, or background tint.
interactionStates.disabled: Muted foreground and disabled surface; maintain legibility.
interactionStates.loading: Stable geometry with a small progress indicator.
interactionStates.error: Semantic error color, concise message, and clear recovery path.

guidelines: Use short transitions for color, opacity, and elevation.
Use modest slide/fade for sheets and dialogs.
Avoid bouncy, ornamental, or continuous motion.
Keep loading indicators calm and unobtrusive.

mediaRules.imagery: Use clean, purposeful imagery with consistent treatment; avoid decorative images that compete with task completion.
mediaRules.illustrations: Prefer simple, friendly, low-detail illustrations that use the established palette.
mediaRules.cropping: Use intentional aspect ratios and consistent corner treatment; do not stretch assets.
mediaRules.backgrounds: Keep interface backgrounds quiet and low contrast so content remains dominant.

consistencyRules: Do not introduce arbitrary colors; extend the semantic palette only when a real use case requires it.
Use the spacing scale and sizing tokens instead of one-off values.
Keep corner radii consistent by component category.
Use shadows sparingly; prefer spacing and borders for grouping.
Maintain the typography scale and sentence-case labels.
Keep primary green reserved for meaningful actions and selected states.
Preserve the established mobile navigation pattern across authenticated screens.
Use consistent icon family, stroke weight, and optical alignment.
Design for accessible contrast and minimum touch targets.
Avoid unnecessary gradients, glossy effects, heavy outlines, and dense decoration.
aiImplementationGuidelines: Treat this JSON as the source of truth for visual decisions when implementing new interface elements.
Use existing design tokens before creating new values; if a token is missing, choose the nearest existing token.
Follow the component specifications and extend shared components rather than creating visually divergent one-off controls.
Maintain the established spacing rhythm, typography hierarchy, color semantics, and radius scale.
Apply responsive behavior by reflowing content according to the defined breakpoints; do not merely scale down desktop layouts.
Keep persistent application navigation consistent across related authenticated views.
Do not copy individual reference screens literally; infer the appropriate structure for the new task from reusable patterns.
When a pattern is not explicitly defined, make the smallest design decision necessary to remain consistent with this system.
Do not introduce a new visual style, palette, icon family, or motion language without a clear product reason.
Prefer accessible, semantic components and preserve keyboard focus visibility and touch target dimensions.
Keep content concise and layouts breathable; avoid adding decorative elements that do not improve comprehension or task completion.
